Marinating thick T Bone steaks in hot wasabi and setting them on metal grates while brushing over rich yakiniku sauce until the crust shines and the edges bubble!🥩🔥
Slicing the steaks on a wooden board, dipping each piece back into warm yakiniku and wasabi mix, and serving a strong T Bone plate that feels like bold steakhouse flavor at home!🏡✨

🔔 Make sure that you have the bell turned on, so you will definitely not miss any of our videos!
